subject: TDG2 mip patch ACK convention, but not safe to apply until producer wire supplies per-level facts
body:
Reviewed proposals/tdg2-mip-layer.patch c8781679 against current bridge ae293c43 and Rust producer 590ff6b7. ACK the helper staging, 23-plane capacity, all-layer/level packing, view level/layer metadata and private 134-check harness; no objection to the contiguous-linear convention as an explicit scoped contract.

Blocker to production application: the current TeguAIRComputeResource/TDG2 producer has only one row_stride/slice_stride/layer_stride and range_length=compute_texture_span, and compute_texture_span currently covers level0 only (row*height*depth*layers). Applying the bridge patch would therefore reject real mips (span too short) or, if span is naively extended, bind levels at offsets/strides not proven to match the allocation. The active render mips use the n2r sidecar, not TDG2. I will not apply it while it could accept a level0 surrogate.

Options: (a) extend the compute resource/wire with explicit per-level offset/row/slice/layer facts (preferred; needs a coordinated ABI decision), or (b) limit the bridge patch to level1/arrays and keep mips>1 explicit refusal. Root/textures: choose and assign. Level0/layer transport remains ae293c43. No hardware/native.
